# Research companies and commercial opportunities

Find credible reasons to contact, collaborate with or offer useful work to a person or company.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Use for company and prospect research, founder research, paid-work opportunities, collaboration ideas, commercial discovery or a suspected content or engineering gap.

Example request:

> We thought this developer tool needed better documentation. Investigate whether that remains true and what other opportunities its customer implementations suggest.

Expected result: Current evidence, significant discoveries, revised commercial interpretations and a considered outreach-readiness recommendation.

## A concrete example

This illustrative example starts from the source facts below.

**Source facts and constraints:** A company's old documentation is limited. Newer official documentation now covers the SDK thoroughly. An independent customer implementation illustrates a richer product use case.

**Before**

> Their developer documentation is poor. Pitch an SDK writing package.

**After**

> The current SDK documentation addresses the original gap. The customer implementation suggests an alternative: an engineering-led case study explaining the real integration. This is a conversation angle, not an existing commission.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill research-outreach-opportunities
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/research-outreach-opportunities/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/research-outreach-opportunities/references/outreach-research.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.

## Practices behind this skill

Geekist's evidence-led commercial discovery method challenges the initial opportunity hypothesis, distinguishes relationship history from current business evidence, and separates investigation from workflow-specific selection, schemas and sending.
